name: Alderic
title: Runewarden of the Crown · Warmaster of the Empire
lore: Appointed Warmaster by Princess Arianna, regent for her ailing father, Alderic commands the empire’s armies. He longs to restore the glory of the Crownlands.

name: Morie
title: Grandmistress of the Northern League
lore: Wise in diplomacy and magic, Morie protects the freedom of the League’s rich cities. For now, that means keeping the empire weak and the Marches at a distance.

name: Bosci
title: Lord of Seacliffe · Leader of the Bright Marches
lore: Once an imperial warlord granted a march as his fief, Bosci has seen the rot behind the court’s splendour. He gathers the petty kings under one banner against their common foe, striving for independence.

name: Dwell
title: The Dwarf · Merchant of the Mountain Clans
lore: The biggest dwarf in the mountains and the biggest merchant outside the Vales, Dwell trades ore and gems with the empire. Imperial gold is good money, whatever troubles the court.

name: The Lonely Wanderer
title: An Unclaimed Path
lore: A mysterious figure appears here and there, belonging to no court or clan. No one knows the Wanderer’s name, origin, or destination.

name: Ilyria
title: Queen of the Elves · Voice of the Conclave
lore: Proud and dangerous, Ilyria places the woods and her people above all else. She shelters druids and tree walkers; intruders are friends or already dead. The empire’s industry threatens her realm as surely as the burning hordes.

name: Hekata
title: Lady of the Ember Fields
lore: A merciless warlord risen in the east, Hekata eyes the empire’s gold and silver. She believes those riches belong to her, not the zealous weaklings sheltering in their towers.

name: Brut
title: Chief of the Harpies · Warlord of the Horde
lore: Brut united the goblin clans beneath the harpy banner. There are no harpies: the clans simply liked the name and the look of the banners. Now he leads them in search of fun and blood.

name: The Dark Priest of Run
title: Master of the Black Host
lore: Always hooded, the Dark Priest of Run gathers vast undead hordes. He seeks to plunge the world into darkness and make Varhyr an everlasting crypt.
